name: 工笔重彩
palette: 石青、石绿、朱砂、赭石、胭脂与局部泥金，多层罩染而不浑浊
lighting: 非摄影式均匀设色，以线描、罩染和金色层次表达体积与礼仪感

composition: 游丝描式细线组织人物关系，服饰纹样、手势和礼仪秩序成为画面核心

style_instructions: Chinese gongbi heavy-color painting, hairline controlled contours, layered mineral pigments, meticulous garments and objects, ceremonial spatial order and restrained gold accents.
